subject: Backend Engineer - Skill Assessment: instructions, submission window, and reviewer schedule
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@gmail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Backend Engineer - Skill Assessment: instructions, submission window, and reviewer schedule

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood Inference. As discussed, attached is the take-home skill assessment for the Backend Engineer role. A few quick notes and options so you can pick what works best for you: 

- Submission windows: standard (72 hours) or expedited (48 hours). Please confirm which you want; if we don't hear back we'll assume standard (deadline: 72 hours from your confirmation).
- Submission method: upload a single .zip to the candidate portal (candidate-portal@hireflow.com) and reply to this thread with the portal confirmation ID.
- Allowed resources: standard public libraries and offline references are fine; do not include any internal Redwood code or proprietary datasets. If in doubt, ask and we'll confirm.
- Review timeline: reviewers (Tessa + Aditya) will triage within 24 hours of submission and aim to complete written feedback within 72 hours afterward.

Links and attachments: assessment PDF + rubric attached and a folder with starter data is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-assessment-packet

If you prefer a different start time or need extra time for a specific reason, tell us and we can accommodate.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- candidate_assessment_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
- assessment_rubric.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@gmail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backend Engineer - Skill Assessment: instructions, submission window, and reviewer schedule

Hi Neha —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear instructions. I can take the standard 72-hour window. A quick question: are we allowed to use external LLM APIs for proof-of-concept parts of the task (clearly labeled), or should all model-related work be limited to local/CPU-only code?

Also confirming I'll upload via the portal and will reply here with the confirmation ID once submitted.

Thanks,
Claire

Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backend Engineer - Skill Assessment: instructions, submission window, and reviewer schedule

Hi Claire —

Good question about external LLMs. You can use external model APIs for prototyping as long as you label their use clearly in your README and include any prompts or evaluation scripts. For fairness we will not penalize usage of public APIs; the rubric emphasizes correctness, design, and reproducibility over specific model choice.

Logistics notes for the team:
- Candidate confirmed standard 72h window. Deadline (if submission confirmed within 2 hours): Sun, May 30 2027 14:30 PDT.
- Please block a triage window: Tessa (on-call reviewer) will triage within 24h of upload; I'll take secondary review. If either reviewer needs to swap slots, reply to this thread.
- Reviewer checklist: completeness, tests pass, README reproduces steps, architecture notes (2–3 bullet summary), and rubric score per section. Rubric attached.

Claire — upload to the portal and paste the portal confirmation ID into this thread. We'll confirm receipt and share the calendar event for the review readout.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer (Hiring Team) | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

(P.S. Tessa — I created a tentative calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=review-slot-AR-TM )
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Backend Engineer - Skill Assessment: instructions, submission window, and reviewer schedule

Quick ops note — CC'ing so this is on record.

- Triage plan: Tessa on-call for initial triage (first 24h), Aditya secondary. If candidate submits late-night PST, we'll still do triage next business morning unless critical issue flagged.
- Swap policy: if anyone is out, set status in the hiring Slack channel #hiring-reviews and ping the other reviewer.
- Post-review: deliver rubrics into /hiring/reviews/YYYYMM and set review doc to comment-only for hiring managers.

Neha — please update the candidate portal instructions to include the note about allowed external APIs and add the calendar event link in the confirmation email.

Thanks,
Aditya
